mapper.select: SELECT org_id, daily_token_limit FROM organization_ai_budget WHERE org_id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_ai_budget (org_id, daily_token_limit) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{dailyTokenLimit}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_token_limit = VALUES(daily_token_limit)
INSERT IGNORE INTO organization_ai_budget_usage (org_id, usage_day, consumed_tokens) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{usageDay}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT org_id, consumed_tokens FROM organization_ai_budget_usage WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND usage_day = #{usageDay} FOR UPDATE

SELECT reservation_id FROM organization_ai_budget_reservation FORCE INDEX (idx_organization_ai_budget_reservation_state_expiry) WHERE state IN ('reserved', 'dispatched') AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY state, expires_at, reservation_id LIMIT 100
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserved_tokens), 0) FROM organization_ai_budget_reservation WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND usage_day = #{usageDay} AND state != 'settled'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_ai_budget_reservation (reservation_id, org_id, usage_day, reserved_tokens, expires_at, state) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{orgId}, #{usageDay}, #{reservedTokens}, #{expiresAt}, 'reserved')
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_ai_budget_reservation SET state = 'dispatched' WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND state = 'reserved'

UPDATE organization_ai_budget_reservation SET state = 'settled', consumed_tokens = #{consumedTokens}, expires_at = GREATEST(expires_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND state != 'settled'
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, org_id, usage_day, reserved_tokens, expires_at, state, consumed_tokens FROM organization_ai_budget_reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization_ai_budget_reservation WHERE state = 'settled' AND expires_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY state, expires_at, reservation_id LIMIT 100
mapper.select: SELECT al.actor_id AS userId, COALESCE(al.actor_label, 'System') AS displayName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.feature')) AS feature, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.inputTokens')) AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS inputUsage, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.outputTokens')) AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS outputUsage FROM audit_log al WHERE al.org_id = #{orgId} AND al.action = 'ai.llm.call' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.outcome')) = 'success' AND al.created_at >= #{usageDay} AND al.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{usageDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY al.actor_id, al.actor_label, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.feature')) ORDER BY inputUsage + outputUsage DESC, displayName ASC, feature ASC
